def test_max_age(self, serializer, value, ts, freeze):
    """Validates the max age functionality of the serializer.

    Ensures that the serializer correctly expires signatures after the specified
    maximum age has been reached.
    """
Args:
    serializer (object): The serializer instance to test.
    value (any): The value to be serialized.
    ts (datetime): The timestamp when the value was serialized.
    freeze (object): A time control object to simulate time passage.

Returns:
    void: This function does not return a value but asserts conditions.
</DOCSTRING>
